claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charlie Gallagher had the articles of agreement read and a final $300 a side deposit made with stakeholder William Murray.
claims.excerpt: and to witness the fina! deposit of $300 a side made into the hands of the stake-holder
places: Mike McCoole's new house, opposite the Court-House

claims.statement: The Allen-Gallagher fight was set for 23 February 1869.
claims.excerpt: approaching prize fight between Tom Allen and Charlie Gallagher, both of Cleveland, to come off on the 23d of this month

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charlie Gallagher were both of Cleveland.
claims.excerpt: approaching prize fight between Tom Allen and Charlie Gallagher, both of Cleveland, to come off on the 23d of this month

notes: Fight of 23 Feb 1869 is recorded from its report in 307. Mike McCoole and others are named as spectators and backers only.
